item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to force the ace of clubs: tapped cards remain if they include it; otherwise they are discarded. On the final tap, the tapped card remains only if it is the ace of clubs; otherwise it is discarded."}
